category: Data Protection Policies, Processes, and Procedures (PR.PO-P)
subcategory_text: Effectiveness of protection technologies is shared.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: PM-15 (Security and Privacy Groups and Associations)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.6 (General information on information security)
GDPR Recital 78 (Adequate safeguards may be demonstrated by certification)
implementation_examples: Share effectiveness information about protection technologies (e.g., anonymisation effectiveness, cryptography effectiveness, evaluation results) with peers through communities, regulatory fora, and public reporting where appropriate
Adopt common metrics (e.g., NIST CSF 2.0 measures) so that comparisons are meaningful
assessment_objectives: Determine whether effectiveness information is shared with appropriate communities
Determine whether sharing uses common metrics and respects confidentiality obligations
Determine whether internal evaluation results feed into shared metrics
Determine whether the sharing programme contributes to improve internal controls
